sources.name: Time Out - The 16 Best Hot Chocolates in London
sources.note: UNORDERED listicle, no ranks carried. DATED 28 OCTOBER 2022 - four years old, and it shares ZERO names with The Infatuation's current guide. Trading status must be checked on every name before any of them reaches an article. Reached via a /blog/ten-indulgent-hot-chocolates URL that redirects here; one page, not two.

quotes.Dark Sugars Cocoa House: The scent of Ghanaian cocoa beans wafts up Brick Lane. Hot chocolate intense, in numerous flavours, covered in real shaved chocolate.
quotes.Chin Chin Dessert Club: A paper cup topped with a giant orb of handmade marshmallow, blowtorched to charred, sticky decadence. Also does a vegan version with raspberry and apricot.
quotes.Rabot 1745: Hotel Chocolat's cafe overlooking Borough Market, named for a cocoa estate founded in 1745 in St Lucia. You can add a shot of St Lucian rum.
quotes.Melange: Peckham, run by chocolatier Isabelle Alaya, OPEN WEEKENDS ONLY as of this list. Salted caramel is the biggest hit; white chocolate with matcha also sold.

sources.name: The Infatuation - The 8 Best Hot Chocolates In London
sources.note: UNORDERED, no ranks. THE FINDING OF THIS PASS: shares not one name with Time Out's 16. Two serious sources, two disjoint lists - the whole-list divergence case in the method, and almost certainly because Time Out's is four years stale.

sources.name: Insider / Food Insider (YouTube)
sources.note: ONE PUBLISHER, TWO CHANNELS, ONE SOURCE. @InsiderFood and @Insider are both Business Insider and are merged here, the same rule that makes a masthead's guide and its YouTube channel one opinion. Four relevant videos, 8.4M views on the largest. Names taken from the descriptions, not the titles.

quotes.Said Dal 1923: A London cafe that sells melted chocolate to drink out of decorative cups. Insider asks whether the Instagram-worthy drink is too gooey and over the top.
quotes.Dark Sugars Cocoa House: 72 kinds of chocolate all made in-house. The base is chocolate paste topped with hot milk, more froth, and three types of chocolate shavings.

sources.name: Rayscafe (YouTube)
sources.note: Lists its four stops in the description under 'Featured hot chocolate spots', which is exactly where the method says to look.

sources.name: thiswasnotwellplanned (YouTube)
sources.note: Description carries full addresses and a per-venue verdict, which is unusually good sourcing for the tier. Description was truncated at capture - RE-READ for the stops after Italian Bear before treating this list as complete.

quotes.William Curley: 33 Smith's Ct, London W1D 7DP. Their review: dark hot chocolate was a bit too sweet and milky for us.

quotes.Italian Bear Chocolate: Poured triple-layered - thick, creamy and smooth.

quotes.Dark Sugars Cocoa House: Films the making of the hot chocolates at the Brick Lane shop.
Filmed at the Shoreditch shop - CHECK WHICH BRANCH, the other sources name Brick Lane.

quotes.Said Dal 1923: Triple chocolate with cinnamon. Located Covent Garden per this source - Time Out's older page calls it Soho. CHECK THE ADDRESS.

declined.name: Time Out - Hot damn! It's your favourite hot chocolate in London
declined.reason: SAME DOMAIN as the Time Out record above, so it could never be a second opinion. Also a READER POLL from 17 November 2015 rather than an editorial list, and eleven years stale. Its names - Said, Dark Sugars, Paul A Young, Cantina Laredo, Cafe Bonito, Betty Blythe, Caffe Vergnano, The Urban Chocolatier - are deliberately NOT merged: an eleven-year-old reader vote is not evidence of current quality, and merging would inflate counts for venues that may not trade.

openVenueQuestions: CHIN CHIN: Time Out writes 'Chin Chin Dessert Club', Insider and Rayscafe write 'Chin Chin Labs'. Recorded here under the Time Out spelling on the assumption they are one business, but this needs confirming and an alias adding - if wrong, it hands a three-source count to a venue that earned less.
DARK SUGARS: named as Brick Lane by Time Out and Halal Gems, Shoreditch by settime2588. Likely two branches of one business - carry as Branches rows, not two venues.
SAID DAL 1923: Covent Garden per Onion Jain, Soho per the 2015 Time Out page. Confirm the address before printing an area.
ITALIAN BEAR CHOCOLATE / 'The Italian Bear': alias needed, 41 Broadwick St W1F 9QL.
